fone8.name: Pear Fone 8
fone8.desc: The classic with the Home button: an LCD screen that opens sideways like a book, Phillips and Tri-point screws. Perfect for learning.

fonex.name: Pear Fone X
fonex.desc: The first one with the notch: OLED screen, face recognition and a very delicate “sandwich” logic board.

fone12.name: Pear Fone 12
fone12.desc: Flat edges and stubborn adhesive: it takes more heat to open, and the camera and battery are paired to the board.

fone14.name: Pear Fone 14
fone14.desc: The latest: the back glass comes off, so many jobs are done by opening it from the rear.
